purpose: Bounded development-only Agent wiring and feedback-revision pilot; no held-out or RSI mechanism claim.

sessions.prompt_input_policy: Trusted runner calls prepare_task for the two prompt IDs only and appends their sorted JSON TaskViews; no development-instance contents are appended to the model prompt.
sessions.evaluation_policy: Evaluate the initial artifact and each submitted candidate on all two prompt and eight development tasks in this fixed order, using the same candidate source.
sessions.selection_rule: Maximize development successes, then prompt successes; exact ties retain the earlier candidate, including the initial artifact. Candidates with infrastructure errors are not assigned a valid selection score.
sessions.early_finish_policy: The Agent may finish earlier; all ten successes is a natural stopping point. No additional hidden evaluation follows.
sessions.initial_candidate_role: Deliberately unsuccessful fixed starting artifact, not a strategy or reference solution.

sessions.evaluation_policy: Fit constants and compute MSE/NMSE on the same official train observations, with fresh-process prediction and host scoring. This is training development feedback.
sessions.selection_rule: Minimize finite train NMSE among successful candidates; exact ties retain the earlier candidate, including the initial artifact. Invalid or failed candidates cannot replace the incumbent.
sessions.early_finish_policy: The Agent may finish earlier but cannot claim discovery or generalization from train error. No test_id/test_ood request is authorized.
sessions.initial_candidate_role: Fixed constant-expression starting artifact, not a strategy or reference equation.

reporting.candidate_parent: current selected incumbent immediately before submission
reporting.claim_boundary: Operational pilot of a fixed revision prompt; two task sessions are not two independent repetitions of a method comparison.

budget_notes.reservation_note: Enforce request/context/output caps and conservative token/cost reservation before sending. Record measured provider usage separately. No unmetered automatic retry.
